systems.system: نظام إصدار الحالة الجنائية والخدمات المصاحبة له (criminal status certificate issuing system and its accompanying services)
systems.owner: Information and Documentation Centre of the Ministry of Interior (Government of National Unity), with the Criminal Investigation Agency
systems.tiers: Being installed at 4 February 2023 at the Criminal Investigation Agency's Jabal al Akhdar branch in Al Bayda, for the eastern region; earlier activated in Benghazi, Sabha, Misrata, Tripoli, Zintan, Gharyan, Janzour and Zuwara

systems.owner: Ministry of Interior, Information and Documentation Centre
systems.tiers: online link through which residents of Al Bayda and nearby areas can request the certificate

note: No fact: the system issues criminal status certificates at Criminal Investigation Agency branches, with an online request form, which are the identification and public classes; nothing concerns a station's record of a report or case. The ministry calls the installation a stage of its digital transformation plan, run through the Information and Documentation Centre.
